# Small G, a null effect and Satterthwaite critical values {#sec-ssn}

```{r ssn-load}
ssn_read <- \(dir, f) readr::read_csv(file.path(dir, f), show_col_types = FALSE, guess_max = 100000)
SSN_SATT <- "satterthwaite/summaries"
SSN_SGN <- "small-g-null/summaries"
ssn_syn <- ssn_read(SSN_SATT, "satt-syn-cells.csv")
ssn_syn_con <- ssn_read(SSN_SATT, "satt-syn-contrasts.csv")
ssn_syn_df <- ssn_read(SSN_SATT, "satt-syn-df.csv")
ssn_syn_info <- ssn_read(SSN_SATT, "satt-syn-info.csv")
ssn_syn_check <- ssn_read(SSN_SATT, "satt-syn-check.csv")
ssn_syn_crn <- ssn_read(SSN_SATT, "satt-syn-crn.csv")
ssn_syn_fail <- ssn_read(SSN_SATT, "satt-syn-failures.csv")
ssn_pm <- ssn_read(SSN_SATT, "satt-plasmode-cells.csv")
ssn_pm_con <- ssn_read(SSN_SATT, "satt-plasmode-contrasts.csv")
ssn_pm_df <- ssn_read(SSN_SATT, "satt-plasmode-df.csv")
ssn_pm_info <- ssn_read(SSN_SATT, "satt-plasmode-info.csv")
ssn_pm_check <- ssn_read(SSN_SATT, "satt-plasmode-check.csv")
ssn_pm_crn <- ssn_read(SSN_SATT, "satt-plasmode-crn.csv")
ssn_pm_fail <- ssn_read(SSN_SATT, "satt-plasmode-failures.csv")
ssn_ladder <- ssn_read(SSN_SGN, "g-ladder.csv")
ssn_ladder_satt <- ssn_read(SSN_SGN, "g-ladder-satt.csv")
ssn_cells <- ssn_read(SSN_SGN, "cells.csv")
ssn_null <- ssn_read(SSN_SGN, "null.csv")
ssn_rel20 <- ssn_read(SSN_SGN, "relative-error.csv")
ssn_fail <- ssn_read(SSN_SGN, "failures.csv")

SSN_LOW <- LEVEL - ADEQUATE
SSN_CRIT <- c(z = "z", t = "t(G−1)", satt = "Satt")
ssn_dep <- \(e) if_else(e == "iid", "independent", "dependent")
# compact labels for the wide G-ladder tables
ssn_compact <- \(df) mutate(df, dependence = c(independent = "indep.", dependent = "dep.")[dependence],
  estimand = c(mean = "mean", beta = "beta", alpha = "alpha", gamma = "gamma")[estimand])
ssn_e <- \(x) formatC(x, format = "e", digits = 1)
ssn_nrep <- unique(c(ssn_syn$n_rep, ssn_pm$n_rep, ssn_cells$n_rep, ssn_null$n_rep))
stopifnot(length(ssn_nrep) == 1)
SSN_G20 <- min(ssn_cells$G[ssn_cells$block == "small_G"])
ssn_cells_g20 <- range(ssn_cells$cell[ssn_cells$block == "small_G"])
ssn_cells_null <- range(ssn_cells$cell[ssn_cells$block == "null_beta"])
SSN_BLOCKS <- c(
  warp = "misregistration", warp_ar1 = "misregistration (AR(1) cell)", dense_grid = "dense grid",
  rough_truth = "rough truth", term_type = "term type f(x,t)", families = "extended families",
  ar1_home = "AR(1) home turf", oscillating = "sign-changing", heteroskedastic = "heteroskedastic",
  lowrank_covariate = "low-rank covariate", basis_size = "basis size",
  small_G = paste0("core, G = ", SSN_G20), null_beta = "β = 0"
)
SSN_ARMS <- c(
  ARM_LABELS[c("reml_model", "reml_cl2")],
  reml_cl2_t = "REML + CL2, t(G−1)", reml_cl2_satt = "REML + CL2, Satt",
  ARM_LABELS[c("ncv_model", "ncv_cl2", "ncv_cl2_bias")]
)
# column prefixes of the wide tables (f(x,t) of the term-type block pooled with beta) and names in the text
ssn_est <- \(e) factor(c(mean = "mean", beta = "beta", f = "beta", alpha = "alpha", gamma = "gamma")[e],
  c("mean", "beta", "alpha", "gamma"))
SSN_EST_TXT <- c(mean = "the mean", beta = "β", f = "f", alpha = "α", gamma = "γ")
ssn_int <- \(x) format(x, big.mark = ",")
```

Three sets of runs, `r ssn_nrep` replicates per cell. (i) Per-point Satterthwaite critical values for REML + CL2
(exact CL2, Bayesian form; as in the Satterthwaite subsection above) on every synthetic cell outside the core
block and on the plasmode cells with curve flips and attached residuals (nine datasets, G = 40 and all subjects;
`satterthwaite/`). (ii) The core factorial at G = `r SSN_G20` (cells `r ssn_cells_g20[1]`–`r ssn_cells_g20[2]`): the
first `r SSN_G20` curves of each replicate, so the cells share their draws with the G = 40 and G = 100 core cells.
(iii) β = 0 (cells `r ssn_cells_null[1]`–`r ssn_cells_null[2]`): the smooth-truth setting at the default signal with
β set to zero, Gaussian and binary, independent and smooth errors, G = 40 and 100 (`small-g-null/`). Critical
values: z = z~0.975~, $t_{G-1}$, and "Satt", the per-point Satterthwaite df of refund's
`coef.pffr(crit = "satterthwaite")` (full Gram matrix).

## Satterthwaite critical values beyond the core cells {#sec-ssn-satt}

```{r ssn-satt}
ssn_info <- bind_rows(synthetic = ssn_syn_info, plasmode = ssn_pm_info, .id = "setting")
ssn_soft <- strsplit(unique(ssn_info$software), " ")[[1]]
ssn_crn_max <- c(synthetic = max(ssn_syn_crn$max_rel), plasmode = max(ssn_pm_crn$max_rel))
ssn_check <- bind_rows(ssn_syn_check, ssn_pm_check)
stopifnot(all(ssn_check$n_rep == ssn_check$n_rep_study), all(ssn_info$G_check))

# extension blocks: everything except the G = 20 and beta = 0 cells (next subsections)
ssn_ext <- ssn_syn |> filter(!block %in% c("small_G", "null_beta"), crit %in% names(SSN_CRIT))
ssn_ext_tab <- ssn_ext |>
  filter(crit %in% c("z", "satt")) |>
  group_by(block, G) |> mutate(cells = n_distinct(cell)) |> ungroup() |>
  group_by(block, G, cells, estimand = ssn_est(estimand), crit) |>
  summarise(coverage = mean(coverage), .groups = "drop") |>
  arrange(estimand, factor(crit, names(SSN_CRIT))) |>
  mutate(col = paste(estimand, SSN_CRIT[crit])) |>
  select(-estimand, -crit) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = col, values_from = coverage) |>
  mutate(block = factor(SSN_BLOCKS[block], SSN_BLOCKS)) |>
  arrange(block, G)
save_tab(ssn_ext_tab, "ssn-satt-extensions")

ssn_low_raw <- ssn_ext |>
  select(cell, block, family, error, G, signal, truth, estimand, crit, coverage, pointwise_q05) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = crit, values_from = c(coverage, pointwise_q05)) |>
  filter(coverage_satt < SSN_LOW) |>
  mutate(block = factor(SSN_BLOCKS[block], SSN_BLOCKS), estimand = factor(estimand, names(SSN_EST_TXT))) |>
  arrange(block, estimand, family, G)
ssn_low <- ssn_low_raw |>
  transmute(block, family, error, G, signal, truth, estimand = as.character(estimand), z = coverage_z,
            `t(G−1)` = coverage_t, Satt = coverage_satt, `q05 Satt` = pointwise_q05_satt) |>
  pretty()
save_tab(ssn_low, "ssn-satt-extensions-low")
ssn_low_text <- ssn_low_raw |>
  group_by(block) |>
  summarise(txt = sprintf("%s (%s; %s)", first(block), paste(unique(FAMILY_LABELS[family]), collapse = ", "),
                          paste(unique(SSN_EST_TXT[as.character(estimand)]), collapse = ", ")), .groups = "drop") |>
  pull(txt) |> paste(collapse = "; ")
ssn_low_min <- slice_min(ssn_low_raw, coverage_satt, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE)

# paired contrasts: extension blocks and plasmode
ssn_con <- bind_rows(
  `synthetic extensions` = ssn_syn_con |> filter(!block %in% c("small_G", "null_beta")) |> mutate(G = as.character(G)),
  plasmode = ssn_pm_con |> mutate(G = if_else(G == 40, "40", "all")),
  .id = "setting"
) |>
  group_by(setting, contrast, G) |>
  summarise(rows = n(), diff_min = min(diff), diff_max = max(diff), diff = mean(diff),
            width_min = min(width_ratio), width_max = max(width_ratio), width_ratio = mean(width_ratio), .groups = "drop") |>
  mutate(across(starts_with("diff"), \(x) 100 * x)) |>
  select(setting, contrast, G, rows, `diff (pp)` = diff, `diff min` = diff_min, `diff max` = diff_max,
         `width ratio` = width_ratio, `width min` = width_min, `width max` = width_max) |>
  arrange(setting, contrast, G)
save_tab(ssn_con, "ssn-satt-contrasts")
ssn_all_con <- bind_rows(ssn_syn_con, ssn_pm_con)
ssn_con_min <- min(ssn_all_con$diff[ssn_all_con$contrast == "Satt - z"])
ssn_sz <- \(ct, g) ssn_con$`diff (pp)`[ssn_con$setting == "synthetic extensions" & ssn_con$contrast == ct & ssn_con$G == g]
ssn_wz <- \(ct, g) ssn_con$`width ratio`[ssn_con$setting == "synthetic extensions" & ssn_con$contrast == ct & ssn_con$G == g]
ssn_pz <- \(ct, g, col = "diff (pp)") ssn_con[[col]][ssn_con$setting == "plasmode" & ssn_con$contrast == ct & ssn_con$G == g]

# plasmode: mean over truth x residual cells per dataset, G and estimand
ssn_pm_tab <- ssn_pm |>
  filter(crit %in% c("z", "satt")) |>
  group_by(app, G) |> mutate(cells = n_distinct(cell)) |> ungroup() |>
  group_by(app, G, cells, estimand = ssn_est(estimand), crit) |>
  summarise(coverage = mean(coverage), .groups = "drop") |>
  arrange(estimand, factor(crit, names(SSN_CRIT))) |>
  mutate(col = paste(estimand, SSN_CRIT[crit])) |>
  select(-estimand, -crit) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = col, values_from = coverage) |>
  mutate(app = label_app(app)) |>
  arrange(app, G)
save_tab(ssn_pm_tab, "ssn-satt-plasmode")
ssn_pm_low <- ssn_pm |>
  filter(crit == "satt") |>
  group_by(app, G, estimand) |>
  summarise(coverage = mean(coverage), .groups = "drop") |>
  filter(coverage < SSN_LOW) |>
  mutate(app = label_app(app), estimand = factor(estimand, names(SSN_EST_TXT))) |>
  arrange(app, estimand, G)
ssn_pm_low_text <- ssn_pm_low |>
  group_by(app, estimand) |>
  summarise(txt = sprintf("%s %s (%s)", first(app), SSN_EST_TXT[[as.character(first(estimand))]],
                          paste(sprintf("%s at G = %d", f(coverage), G), collapse = ", ")), .groups = "drop") |>
  pull(txt) |> paste(collapse = "; ")

# per-point df
ssn_df_tab <- bind_rows(
  synthetic = ssn_syn_df |> mutate(G = as.character(G)),
  plasmode = ssn_pm_df |> mutate(G = if_else(G == 40, "40", "all")),
  .id = "setting"
) |>
  group_by(setting, G, estimand = ssn_est(estimand)) |>
  summarise(cells = n(), `df min` = min(df_median), `df max` = max(df_median),
            `df/(G−1) min` = min(df_median_rel), `df/(G−1) median` = median(df_median_rel),
            `df/(G−1) max` = max(df_median_rel), undefined = sum(n_na), .groups = "drop") |>
  arrange(setting, factor(G, c("20", "40", "100", "all")), estimand)
save_tab(ssn_df_tab, "ssn-satt-df")
ssn_dfr <- \(setting, est) {
  d <- if (setting == "synthetic") ssn_syn_df else ssn_pm_df
  d$df_median_rel[d$estimand %in% est]
}
```

**Checks.** Task files: `r ssn_int(ssn_syn_info$n_files)` synthetic and `r ssn_int(ssn_pm_info$n_files)` plasmode,
`r sum(ssn_info$n_failed) + nrow(ssn_syn_fail) + nrow(ssn_pm_fail)` failed. The REML estimates, CL2 SEs,
model-based SEs and truths reproduce the study's stored records of the same replicates (`r ssn_int(ssn_syn_info$crn_tasks)`
synthetic and `r ssn_int(ssn_pm_info$crn_tasks)` plasmode task records; largest relative difference
`r ssn_e(ssn_crn_max["synthetic"])` and `r ssn_e(ssn_crn_max["plasmode"])`). Scored with z, coverage equals the
study's REML + CL2 summary in all `r nrow(ssn_check)` cell × estimand rows compared (largest absolute difference
`r ssn_e(max(abs(ssn_check$diff)))`, the same replicate count in every row). The CL2 covariance rebuilt from the df
computation equals refund's (largest relative difference `r ssn_e(max(ssn_info$core_check_max))`), the df use the
cell's G in every replicate, and `r sum(ssn_info$n_df_na)` per-point df are undefined. Software: refund
`r substr(ssn_soft[1], 1, 8)`, mgcv `r ssn_soft[2]`.

**Synthetic extensions.** Satterthwaite `r if (ssn_con_min >= 0) "never gives lower coverage than z" else "can give lower coverage than z"`: the smallest paired difference over all
synthetic and plasmode cell × estimand rows is `r pp(ssn_con_min, 2)`.
Over the extension blocks it adds `r f(ssn_sz("Satt - z", "40"), 2)` pp at G = 40 and
`r f(ssn_sz("Satt - z", "100"), 2)` pp at G = 100 on average (mean width ratio `r f(ssn_wz("Satt - z", "40"))` and
`r f(ssn_wz("Satt - z", "100"))`; @tbl-ssn-con). Coverage under Satterthwaite is below
`r f(SSN_LOW, 2)` in `r nrow(ssn_low)` cell × estimand rows (@tbl-ssn-low): `r ssn_low_text`. The lowest is
`r FAMILY_LABELS[[ssn_low_min$family]]` `r SSN_EST_TXT[[as.character(ssn_low_min$estimand)]]` in the
`r ssn_low_min$block` block at G = `r ssn_low_min$G` (`r f(ssn_low_min$coverage_satt)`; z `r f(ssn_low_min$coverage_z)`).

**Plasmode.** Satterthwaite adds `r f(ssn_pz("Satt - z", "40"), 2)` pp at G = 40 and
`r f(ssn_pz("Satt - z", "all"), 2)` pp with all subjects on average (width ratio
`r f(ssn_pz("Satt - z", "40", "width ratio"))` and `r f(ssn_pz("Satt - z", "all", "width ratio"))`). Averaged over
truth and residual sources, coverage stays below `r f(SSN_LOW, 2)` for `r ssn_pm_low_text` (@tbl-ssn-pm). The curve
sign flips make the plasmode curves independent, so these shortfalls do not come from dependence between curves.

**Degrees of freedom.** For β (f), γ and the mean, the median per-point df of a cell is
`r rng(ssn_dfr("synthetic", c("beta", "f", "gamma", "mean")))` times G − 1 over all synthetic cells outside the core
block (including G = `r SSN_G20` and β = 0; median over cells
`r f(median(ssn_dfr("synthetic", c("beta", "f", "gamma", "mean"))), 2)`) and
`r rng(ssn_dfr("plasmode", c("beta", "gamma", "mean")))` on the plasmode cells (median
`r f(median(ssn_dfr("plasmode", c("beta", "gamma", "mean"))), 2)`); for α it is
`r rng(ssn_dfr("synthetic", "alpha"))` (plasmode `r rng(ssn_dfr("plasmode", "alpha"))`; @tbl-ssn-df). For these
terms the Satterthwaite reference thus amounts to a t distribution with far fewer df than $t_{G-1}$.

```{r}
#| label: tbl-ssn-ext
#| tbl-cap: "Synthetic extension blocks: coverage of REML + CL2 with z and Satterthwaite critical values, mean over the block's cells per G and estimand (beta: f(x,t) in the term-type block). Misregistration GLM cells score the mean only."
show(ssn_ext_tab)
```

```{r}
#| label: tbl-ssn-low
#| tbl-cap: "Synthetic extension cells in which REML + CL2 with the Satterthwaite critical value covers less than 0.93 (nominal 0.95 minus the 2 pp adequacy margin): coverage with z, t(G − 1) and Satterthwaite, and the Satterthwaite 5% pointwise quantile."
show(ssn_low)
```

```{r}
#| label: tbl-ssn-con
#| tbl-cap: "Paired critical-value contrasts for REML + CL2, synthetic extension blocks and plasmode cells: coverage difference in pp (mean, minimum and maximum over cell × estimand rows) and width ratio. Satt diag: diagonal Gram matrix; Satt B2: df rescaled to the Bayesian variance."
show(ssn_con, digits = 3)
```

```{r}
#| label: tbl-ssn-pm
#| tbl-cap: "Plasmode cells (curve flips, attached residuals): coverage of REML + CL2 with z and Satterthwaite critical values per dataset and G, mean over truth × residual sources."
show(ssn_pm_tab)
```

```{r}
#| label: tbl-ssn-df
#| tbl-cap: "Per-point Satterthwaite df: range over cells of the cell's median df, and the cell median relative to G − 1 (minimum, median, maximum over cells); synthetic cells outside the core block, plasmode cells by G (all = all subjects). Undefined: per-point df that were NA."
show(ssn_df_tab, digits = 2)
```

## The core factorial at G = 20 {#sec-ssn-g20}

```{r ssn-g20}
SSN_BGM <- c("beta", "gamma", "mean")
ssn_lad <- ssn_ladder |>
  filter(arm %in% MAIN_ARMS) |>
  mutate(dependence = ssn_dep(error))
ssn_lad_sum <- ssn_lad |>
  group_by(family, dependence, estimand, arm, G) |>
  summarise(cells = n(), cov_se = sqrt(sum(coverage_se^2)) / n(), coverage = mean(coverage_mean),
            q05_min = min(pointwise_q05), q05 = mean(pointwise_q05), .groups = "drop")
ssn_alpha_min <- ssn_lad_sum |>
  filter(arm == "reml_cl2", dependence == "dependent", G == SSN_G20, estimand == "alpha") |>
  slice_min(coverage, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) |>
  pull(family) |> (\(x) FAMILY_LABELS[[x]])()
ssn_ls <- \(a, dep, g = SSN_G20, est = c("mean", "beta", "gamma", "alpha"), fam = c("gaussian", "poisson", "binomial"), col = "coverage")
  ssn_lad_sum[[col]][ssn_lad_sum$arm == a & ssn_lad_sum$dependence == dep & ssn_lad_sum$G %in% g &
                     ssn_lad_sum$estimand %in% est & ssn_lad_sum$family %in% fam]

# G = 20: coverage (5% quantile) per arm
ssn_g20_tab <- ssn_lad_sum |>
  filter(G == SSN_G20) |>
  arrange(factor(arm, MAIN_ARMS)) |>
  mutate(v = sprintf("%s (%s)", f(coverage), f(q05, 2)), arm = ARM_LABELS[arm]) |>
  select(family, dependence, estimand, arm, v) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = arm, values_from = v) |>
  mutate(family = label_family(family), estimand = label_estimand(estimand)) |>
  arrange(family, desc(dependence), estimand)
save_tab(ssn_g20_tab, "ssn-g20-coverage")

# G ladder of REML + CL2 and NCV + CL2, and REML + CL2's width relative to G = 40
ssn_width <- ssn_lad |>
  filter(arm == "reml_cl2", G %in% c(SSN_G20, 40)) |>
  select(family, signal, error, dependence, estimand, G, width_mean) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = G, values_from = width_mean, names_prefix = "w") |>
  mutate(ratio = .data[[paste0("w", SSN_G20)]] / w40)
ssn_ladder_tab <- ssn_lad_sum |>
  filter(arm %in% c("reml_cl2", "ncv_cl2")) |>
  arrange(desc(arm), G) |>
  mutate(col = paste(c(reml_cl2 = "REML", ncv_cl2 = "NCV")[arm], G)) |>
  select(family, dependence, estimand, col, coverage) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = col, values_from = coverage) |>
  left_join(ssn_width |> group_by(family, dependence, estimand) |>
              summarise(width = exp(mean(log(ratio))), .groups = "drop"),
            by = c("family", "dependence", "estimand")) |>
  mutate(family = label_family(family)) |>
  arrange(family, desc(dependence), estimand) |>
  ssn_compact()
save_tab(ssn_ladder_tab, "ssn-g-ladder")

# Satterthwaite at G = 20 (mid signal only), with G = 40 and 100
ssn_gs <- ssn_ladder_satt |>
  filter(crit %in% names(SSN_CRIT)) |>
  mutate(dependence = ssn_dep(error)) |>
  group_by(family, dependence, estimand, crit, G) |>
  summarise(coverage = mean(coverage), q05 = mean(pointwise_q05), .groups = "drop")
ssn_gss <- \(crit, dep, g = SSN_G20, est = c("mean", "beta", "gamma"), fam = c("gaussian", "poisson", "binomial"))
  ssn_gs$coverage[ssn_gs$crit == crit & ssn_gs$dependence == dep & ssn_gs$G == g & ssn_gs$estimand %in% est & ssn_gs$family %in% fam]
ssn_gs_tab <- ssn_gs |>
  filter(G == SSN_G20 | crit != "t") |>
  mutate(col = paste(c(z = "z", t = "t", satt = "Satt")[crit], G)) |>
  select(family, dependence, estimand, col, coverage) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = col, values_from = coverage) |>
  left_join(ssn_gs |> filter(G == SSN_G20, crit == "satt") |> select(family, dependence, estimand, q05),
            by = c("family", "dependence", "estimand")) |>
  rename(!!paste("q05", SSN_G20) := q05) |>
  mutate(family = label_family(family)) |>
  arrange(family, desc(dependence), estimand) |>
  ssn_compact()
ssn_gs_tab <- ssn_gs_tab[, c("family", "dependence", "estimand",
  paste(c("z", "t", "Satt", "q05"), SSN_G20), "z 40", "Satt 40", "z 100", "Satt 100")]
save_tab(ssn_gs_tab, "ssn-g20-satterthwaite")

# relative error and detection, G = 20 / 40 / 100 (G = 40 and 100: the study's core cells)
ssn_keys <- ssn_ladder |> distinct(cell, family, signal, error, G)
ssn_rel <- bind_rows(read_summary("final", "relative-error") |> filter(cell %in% ssn_keys$cell), ssn_rel20) |>
  filter(estimand %in% c("beta", "mean"), arm %in% c("reml_cl2", "ncv_cl2", "ncv_cl2_bias")) |>
  inner_join(ssn_keys, by = "cell") |>
  mutate(dependence = ssn_dep(error))
ssn_rel_wide <- ssn_rel |>
  select(cell, family, signal, error, dependence, G, estimand, arm, rel_rmse_cell, rel_rmse_median, detect) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = arm, values_from = c(rel_rmse_cell, rel_rmse_median, detect))
ssn_rel_tab <- ssn_rel_wide |>
  group_by(estimand, family, dependence, G) |>
  summarise(cells = n(),
            `REML cell` = median(rel_rmse_cell_reml_cl2), `NCV cell` = median(rel_rmse_cell_ncv_cl2),
            `REML med.` = median(rel_rmse_median_reml_cl2), `NCV med.` = median(rel_rmse_median_ncv_cl2),
            `det. REML` = mean(detect_reml_cl2), `det. NCV-b` = mean(detect_ncv_cl2_bias),
            .groups = "drop") |>
  mutate(family = label_family(family)) |>
  arrange(desc(estimand), family, desc(dependence), G)
ssn_rel_ord <- with(ssn_rel_tab |> filter(estimand == "beta", dependence == "dependent", G == SSN_G20),
  all(`NCV cell` < `REML cell`))
ssn_rel_tab <- ssn_compact(ssn_rel_tab)
save_tab(ssn_rel_tab, "ssn-g-ladder-relative-error")
ssn_rt <- \(est, fam, dep, g, col) ssn_rel_tab[[col]][ssn_rel_tab$estimand == est &
  ssn_rel_tab$family == label_family(fam) & ssn_rel_tab$dependence == c(independent = "indep.", dependent = "dep.")[[dep]] &
  ssn_rel_tab$G == g]
ssn_det <- \(col, g) ssn_rel_tab[[col]][ssn_rel_tab$estimand == "beta" & ssn_rel_tab$dependence == "dep." & ssn_rel_tab$G == g]
ssn_rel_text <- vapply(c("gaussian", "poisson", "binomial"), \(fam) sprintf("%s %s vs %s",
  FAMILY_LABELS[[fam]], f(ssn_rt("beta", fam, "dependent", SSN_G20, "NCV med."), 2),
  f(ssn_rt("beta", fam, "dependent", SSN_G20, "REML med."), 2)), "") |> paste(collapse = ", ")
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-ssn-ladder
#| fig-cap: "Coverage of the four main intervals by number of curves G (log scale), mean over the core cells of each family and dependence class (all signal levels; dependent = OU and smooth errors); bars ± 2 MC SE, dashed: nominal 0.95."
#| fig-height: 6.5
d <- ssn_lad_sum |>
  mutate(arm = label_arm(arm), estimand = label_estimand(estimand),
         panel = factor(paste(FAMILY_LABELS[family], dependence, sep = "\n"),
                        as.vector(outer(FAMILY_LABELS[c("gaussian", "poisson", "binomial")], c("independent", "dependent"), paste, sep = "\n"))))
fig <- ggplot(d, aes(G, coverage, colour = arm)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = LEVEL, linetype = 2, colour = "grey40") +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_pointrange(aes(ymin = coverage - 2 * cov_se, ymax = coverage + 2 * cov_se), size = 0.15) +
  facet_grid(estimand ~ panel, scales = "free_y") +
  scale_x_log10(breaks = sort(unique(d$G)), expand = expansion(mult = 0.12)) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = ARM_COLOURS, name = NULL) +
  labs(x = "G (number of curves)", y = "coverage (grid average)") +
  theme_doc +
  theme(panel.spacing.x = unit(0.9, "lines"), axis.text.x = element_text(size = 6.5))
save_fig(fig, "ssn-g-ladder-coverage", 7, 6.5)
fig
```

**Coverage.** With dependent errors, REML + CL2 covers β, γ and the mean
`r rng(ssn_ls("reml_cl2", "dependent", est = SSN_BGM))` at G = `r SSN_G20` (means over cells per family and
estimand), against `r rng(ssn_ls("reml_cl2", "dependent", 40, est = SSN_BGM))` at G = 40 and
`r rng(ssn_ls("reml_cl2", "dependent", 100, est = SSN_BGM))` at G = 100; for α the values are
`r rng(ssn_ls("reml_cl2", "dependent", est = "alpha"))`, `r rng(ssn_ls("reml_cl2", "dependent", 40, est = "alpha"))`
and `r rng(ssn_ls("reml_cl2", "dependent", 100, est = "alpha"))`, lowest for `r ssn_alpha_min` responses (@fig-ssn-ladder, @tbl-ssn-g20). NCV + CL2 drops to
`r rng(ssn_ls("ncv_cl2", "dependent"))`, with 5% pointwise quantiles down to
`r f(min(ssn_ls("ncv_cl2", "dependent", col = "q05_min")), 2)`; it should not be used at this G. The bias-aware NCV
interval covers `r rng(ssn_ls("ncv_cl2_bias", "dependent"))` and the model-based REML interval
`r rng(ssn_ls("reml_model", "dependent"))`. With independent errors, binary α and γ undercover for every arm,
including the model-based interval (`r rng(c(ssn_ls("reml_model", "independent", est = c("alpha", "gamma"), fam = "binomial"), ssn_ls("reml_cl2", "independent", est = c("alpha", "gamma"), fam = "binomial"), ssn_ls("ncv_cl2", "independent", est = c("alpha", "gamma"), fam = "binomial"), ssn_ls("ncv_cl2_bias", "independent", est = c("alpha", "gamma"), fam = "binomial")))`;
model-based `r f(ssn_ls("reml_model", "independent", est = "alpha", fam = "binomial"))` for α and
`r f(ssn_ls("reml_model", "independent", est = "gamma", fam = "binomial"))` for γ), so this shortfall is a
small-sample problem of the binary fit, not of the sandwich. REML + CL2 intervals at G = `r SSN_G20` are
`r rng(ssn_width$ratio)` times as wide as at G = 40 (per cell; geometric mean `r f(exp(mean(log(ssn_width$ratio))), 2)`;
@tbl-ssn-ladder).

**Satterthwaite at G = `r SSN_G20`** (mid signal only; the Satterthwaite runs cover only the mid-signal cells at
this G). With dependent errors, REML + CL2 with the Satterthwaite critical value covers
`r rng(ssn_gss("satt", "dependent"))` for β, γ and the mean, against `r rng(ssn_gss("z", "dependent"))` with z and
`r rng(ssn_gss("t", "dependent"))` with $t_{G-1}$ (@tbl-ssn-g20-satt). Binary α stays at
`r f(ssn_gss("satt", "dependent", est = "alpha", fam = "binomial"))` (dependent) and
`r f(ssn_gss("satt", "independent", est = "alpha", fam = "binomial"))` (independent). With independent Gaussian and
Poisson errors Satterthwaite overcovers β, γ and the mean (`r rng(ssn_gss("satt", "independent", fam = c("gaussian", "poisson")), 3)`).

**Accuracy and detection.** At G = `r SSN_G20` with dependent errors, the per-replicate median relative error of β
is `r ssn_rel_text` (NCV vs REML; medians over cells)`r if (ssn_rel_ord) ", and the cell-level relative RMSE is also lower for NCV in every family" else ""`
(@tbl-ssn-relerr). Detection of clearly non-zero β is `r rng(ssn_det("det. REML", SSN_G20))` for REML + CL2 and
`r rng(ssn_det("det. NCV-b", SSN_G20))` for the bias-aware NCV interval (G = 100: `r rng(ssn_det("det. REML", 100))`
and `r rng(ssn_det("det. NCV-b", 100))`).

```{r}
#| label: tbl-ssn-g20
#| tbl-cap: "Core factorial at G = 20: coverage (mean 5% pointwise quantile) per arm, mean over the cells of each family, dependence class and estimand (all signal levels)."
show(ssn_g20_tab)
```

```{r}
#| label: tbl-ssn-ladder
#| tbl-cap: "Coverage of REML + CL2 (REML) and NCV + CL2 (NCV) at G = 20, 40 and 100 (core cells, all signal levels, mean over cells), and the width of REML + CL2 at G = 20 relative to G = 40 (width; geometric mean of per-cell ratios)."
show(ssn_ladder_tab)
```

```{r}
#| label: tbl-ssn-g20-satt
#| tbl-cap: "REML + CL2 with z, t(G − 1) and Satterthwaite critical values, core cells at mid signal: coverage at G = 20 (q05: the Satterthwaite 5% pointwise quantile), 40 and 100, mean over the cells of each family, dependence class and estimand."
show(ssn_gs_tab)
```

```{r}
#| label: tbl-ssn-relerr
#| tbl-cap: "Relative error of the REML and NCV estimates (cell level: root of the cell's MSE over the truth's mean square; rep. median: med.: median over replicates of the per-replicate relative error), median over cells, and detection of clearly non-zero β (mean over cells) for REML + CL2 and the bias-aware NCV interval (NCV-b), core cells by G."
show(ssn_rel_tab)
```

## A null effect: β = 0 {#sec-ssn-null}

```{r ssn-null}
ssn_nl <- ssn_null |>
  mutate(arm_label = factor(SSN_ARMS[arm], SSN_ARMS), family = label_family(family)) |>
  arrange(family, desc(error), G, arm_label)
ssn_fpr_tab <- ssn_nl |>
  mutate(v = sprintf("%s (%s)", f(100 * fpr, 1), f(100 * fpr_se, 1))) |>
  select(family, error, G, arm_label, v) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = arm_label, values_from = v) |>
  pretty()
save_tab(ssn_fpr_tab, "ssn-null-fpr")
ssn_excl_tab <- ssn_nl |>
  mutate(v = sprintf("%s / %s", f(any_excl, 2), f(share_gt_5pct, 2))) |>
  select(family, error, G, arm_label, v) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = arm_label, values_from = v) |>
  pretty()
save_tab(ssn_excl_tab, "ssn-null-exclusion")
ssn_rms <- ssn_null |>
  filter(arm %in% c("reml_cl2", "ncv_cl2")) |>
  select(cell, family, error, G, arm, rms) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = arm, values_from = rms) |>
  transmute(family = label_family(family), error, G, `RMS REML` = reml_cl2, `RMS NCV` = ncv_cl2,
            `NCV / REML` = ncv_cl2 / reml_cl2) |>
  arrange(family, desc(error), G) |>
  pretty()
save_tab(ssn_rms, "ssn-null-rms")
ssn_n <- \(a, fam = c("gaussian", "binomial"), err = c("iid", "fpc"), g = c(40, 100), col = "fpr")
  ssn_null[[col]][ssn_null$arm == a & ssn_null$family %in% fam & ssn_null$error %in% err & ssn_null$G %in% g]
ssn_rr <- \(err) ssn_rms$`NCV / REML`[ssn_rms$error == SHORT_ERROR[[err]]]

# the other estimands in the null cells, with REML + CL2 in the matching core cell (same alpha and gamma truths)
ssn_null_keys <- ssn_cells |> filter(block == "null_beta") |> distinct(cell, family, error, G, signal)
ssn_core_ref <- S |>
  filter(block == "core", truth == "smooth", arm == "reml_cl2", estimand %in% c("alpha", "gamma")) |>
  select(family, error, G, signal, estimand, core = coverage_mean)
ssn_null_other <- ssn_cells |>
  filter(block == "null_beta", estimand != "beta", arm %in% MAIN_ARMS) |>
  select(family, error, G, signal, estimand, arm, coverage_mean) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = arm, values_from = coverage_mean) |>
  left_join(ssn_core_ref, by = c("family", "error", "G", "signal", "estimand"))
ssn_null_other_tab <- ssn_null_other |>
  select(family, error, G, estimand, all_of(MAIN_ARMS), `REML + CL2, core cell` = core) |>
  mutate(family = label_family(family), estimand = label_estimand(estimand)) |>
  arrange(family, desc(error), G, estimand) |>
  pretty()
save_tab(ssn_null_other_tab, "ssn-null-other-estimands")
ssn_no <- \(a, err, est = c("mean", "alpha", "gamma"), fam = c("gaussian", "binomial"))
  ssn_null_other[[a]][ssn_null_other$error == err & ssn_null_other$estimand %in% est & ssn_null_other$family %in% fam]
ssn_core_diff <- with(ssn_null_other, reml_cl2[!is.na(core)] - core[!is.na(core)])
ssn_no_min <- slice_min(ssn_null_other, reml_cl2, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE)
# EDF of the REML ff term in the matching non-null core cell of the Gaussian, independent-error G = 40 null cell
ssn_edf_ref <- EDF |>
  filter(block == "core", truth == "smooth", family == "gaussian", error == "iid", G == 40, signal == "mid",
         fit == "REML", grepl("^te\\(", term)) |>
  pull(edf_mean)
stopifnot(length(ssn_edf_ref) == 1)
ssn_gi40 <- \(a, col = "fpr") ssn_n(a, "gaussian", "iid", 40, col)
```

**Pointwise false-positive rate** (share of grid points whose interval excludes zero; nominal 5%; @tbl-ssn-fpr).
With smooth errors, REML + CL2 has `r rng_pp(ssn_n("reml_cl2", err = "fpc"))`, with $t_{G-1}$
`r rng_pp(ssn_n("reml_cl2_t", err = "fpc"))` and with Satterthwaite `r rng_pp(ssn_n("reml_cl2_satt", err = "fpc"))`.
The model-based intervals reach `r rng_pp(ssn_n("reml_model", err = "fpc"))` (REML) and
`r rng_pp(ssn_n("ncv_model", err = "fpc"))` (NCV), NCV + CL2 `r rng_pp(ssn_n("ncv_cl2", err = "fpc"))`. With
independent errors REML + CL2 has `r rng_pp(ssn_n("reml_cl2", err = "iid", g = 100))` at G = 100 and
`r rng_pp(ssn_n("reml_cl2", fam = "binomial", err = "iid", g = 40))` for binary at G = 40.

The exception is Gaussian, independent errors, G = 40: REML + CL2 has `r pp(ssn_gi40("reml_cl2"))`
(MC SE `r pp(ssn_gi40("reml_cl2", "fpr_se"))`) and Satterthwaite `r pp(ssn_gi40("reml_cl2_satt"))`, against
`r pp(ssn_n("reml_cl2", "gaussian", "iid", 100))` at G = 100. The excluded points are concentrated in a minority of
replicates: `r f(ssn_gi40("reml_cl2", "share_gt_5pct"), 2)` of the replicates have more than 5% of the grid
excluding zero, and the 90% quantile of the per-replicate share is `r f(ssn_gi40("reml_cl2", "fpr_q90"), 2)`. Under
β = 0 the REML fit shrinks β close to the null space of its penalty in most replicates, and in the remaining ones
a large part of the grid excludes zero. This is the known weakness of
Bayesian smoother intervals for terms shrunk to the penalty null space (Marra and Wood, 2012). It does not carry
over to the non-null core cells, where the REML ff term is far from the null space (mean EDF
`r f(ssn_edf_ref, 1)` in the matching core cell).

The bias-aware NCV interval has the lowest rate under smooth errors
(`r rng_pp(ssn_n("ncv_cl2_bias", err = "fpc"))`). Its variance is the NCV + CL2 variance plus (NCV − REML)², and
under β = 0 the REML estimate is noisy (RMS `r rng(ssn_rms[["RMS REML"]][ssn_rms$error == SHORT_ERROR[["fpc"]]])`
against `r rng(ssn_rms[["RMS NCV"]][ssn_rms$error == SHORT_ERROR[["fpc"]]])` for NCV), so the low rate reflects
inflated widths, not calibration.

**Replicates with excluded points** (descriptive; @tbl-ssn-excl). Under smooth errors,
`r rng(ssn_n("reml_cl2", err = "fpc", col = "any_excl"), 2)` of the replicates have at least one grid point where the
REML + CL2 interval excludes zero (`r rng(ssn_n("reml_cl2_satt", err = "fpc", col = "any_excl"), 2)` with
Satterthwaite) and `r rng(ssn_n("reml_cl2", err = "fpc", col = "share_gt_5pct"), 2)` have more than 5% of the grid
excluding zero. These shares are not error rates: the intervals are pointwise, and a statement that β is zero
everywhere needs a simultaneous band or a global test, which this study does not evaluate.

**Size of the null estimate** (@tbl-ssn-rms; RMS over the grid, mean over replicates). The NCV estimate is
`r rng(ssn_rr("fpc"))` times the REML estimate's RMS under smooth errors and `r rng(ssn_rr("iid"))` times under
independent errors.

**Other estimands** (@tbl-ssn-other). REML + CL2 covers the mean, α and γ at
`r rng(ssn_no("reml_cl2", "fpc"))` under smooth errors and `r rng(ssn_no("reml_cl2", "iid"))` under independent
errors; for α and γ the difference to the matching non-null core cell is `r rng_pp(ssn_core_diff)`. Its lowest value
is `r SSN_EST_TXT[[ssn_no_min$estimand]]` in the `r FAMILY_LABELS[[ssn_no_min$family]]` cell with `r ERROR_LABELS[[ssn_no_min$error]]`
errors at G = `r ssn_no_min$G` (`r f(ssn_no_min$reml_cl2)`). NCV + CL2 covers `r rng(ssn_no("ncv_cl2", "fpc"))` under
smooth errors, the bias-aware NCV interval `r rng(ssn_no("ncv_cl2_bias", "fpc"))`.

```{r}

#| tbl-cap: "β = 0: pointwise false-positive rate in % (MC SE), the share of grid points whose 95% interval excludes zero, mean over replicates. Bias-aware: NCV + CL2 with the squared NCV − REML difference added to the variance."
show(ssn_fpr_tab)
```

```{r}
#| label: tbl-ssn-excl
#| tbl-cap: "β = 0, descriptive: share of replicates with at least one grid point excluding zero / with more than 5% of the grid excluding zero. Not error rates (pointwise intervals)."
show(ssn_excl_tab)
```

```{r}
#| label: tbl-ssn-rms
#| tbl-cap: "β = 0: RMS of the REML and NCV estimates of β over the grid (mean over replicates) and their ratio."
show(ssn_rms)
```
